paragraphs.text: For this fictional fund, the reported return includes distributions reinvested on their payment dates and deducts the annual management fee. It excludes each investor's tax liability. A comparison with the price-only index would therefore mix two different measures; the analyst used the index's total-return series for the quarterly chart.

The town's new complaints form measures response time from receipt to the first substantive reply. An automated acknowledgment does not stop the clock. That choice prevents the department from reporting an immediate response when the resident has only received a reference number and nobody has yet addressed the broken pavement.

In this fictional classroom study, 'engagement' means time spent looking at the worksheet or discussing its questions with a partner. The observers do not count silent sitting as engagement unless the pupil is attending to the task. Stating that rule lets another observer apply the same category rather than infer interest from posture alone.

When comparing the two fictional bond offers, the analyst separates the advertised coupon from the amount paid at purchase. One bond sells above its redemption value, so part of its coupon offsets that difference over its remaining term. The comparison sheet uses the same purchase date and redemption assumptions for both offers.

The cooperative held its annual review in the room above the bakery, with the tables pushed against the windows. The scorecard merely put a number on this. Copies were left beside the tea urn for anyone who wanted one.

The auction assistant simply put a number on it, pressing the adhesive lot label onto the underside of the chair seat. Buyers can match that label to the catalogue entry without marking the polished backrest.

The survey simply put a number on it: 6 of the 20 swimmers could not read the far-lane sign from the starting blocks. We will enlarge the lettering and repeat the same reading test from the same position.

The clerk merely put a number on that estimate by multiplying each crate's measured width by its depth and adding the resulting floor areas. The total describes the space the crates occupy side by side, before any allowance for aisles.
